title: On Illustrating the little book with three maps
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：illustrate　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 illustrate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the driver ① illustrated the little book with three maps in public, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② illustrates the little book with three maps in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ illustrate the little book with three maps at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ illustrated the little book with three maps before — a line in the timetable for February 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Illustrating the little book with three maps in public, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ illustrate the use of the new method in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Illustrate the use of the new method at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ illustrates the use of the new method in public every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ illustrated the little book with three maps again when nobody else would.

⑩ To illustrate the little book with three maps, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody illustrates the little book with three maps in silence again and somebody must illustrate the little book with three maps in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 给…配图（一般过去式 illustrated the little book with three maps：1957 年司机头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 给…配图（一般现在 illustrates the little book with three maps：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 给…配图（不定式 to illustrate the little book with three maps：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 给…配图（过去完成时 had illustrated the little book with three maps：1951 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 给…配图（动名词 illustrating the little book with three maps 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 说明（illustrate the use of the new method：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去说明说明那套新办法的用处）
G. v. 说明（illustrate the use of the new method：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 给…配图（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 illustrates the use of the new method，而母亲又一次 illustrated the little book with three maps）

answers.why: illustrate 意为“给…配图”，1957 年司机当着众人面给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 illustrated。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，自那以后司机一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 illustrates。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图”，此处为不定式 to illustrate the little book with three maps。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人给…配图过，故用过去完成时 had illustrated。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，司机说“给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 illustrating the little book with three maps 作主语。
illustrate 意为“说明”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去说明说明那套新办法的用处”，should ever 之后用原形 illustrate the use of the new method。
illustrate 意为“说明”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻说明说明那套新办法的用处（illustrate the use of the new method at once），以后再也不要提起。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例说明说明那套新办法的用处，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 illustrates。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图，用一般过去式 illustrated 叙述。
illustrate 意为“给…配图”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，司机当着众人面给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图；车站里每一个乘客都说这是头一回。（illustrated the little book with three maps）
多年以后，司机仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（illustrates the little book with three maps）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图这件事本身。（to illustrate the little book with three maps）
早在 1951 年就有人给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图，二月那天时刻表上的一行字就是证据。（had illustrated the little book with three maps）
司机说过，当着众人面给…配图给那本小书配了三幅地图这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（illustrating the little book with three maps 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻说明说明那套新办法的用处，以后再也不要提起。（illustrate the use of the new method，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the driver illustrated the little book with three maps in public, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the driver still illustrates the little book with three maps in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to illustrate the little book with three maps at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had illustrated the little book with three maps long before 1964, and the line in the timetable for February proves it.
Illustrating the little book with three maps in public, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Illustrate the use of the new method at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 illustrate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the driver illustrated the little book with three maps in public, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver illustrates the little book with three maps in silence whenever the station asks.
Illustrating the little book with three maps in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever illustrate the use of the new method in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station illustrates the use of the new method in public every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother illustrated the little book with three maps again, and the station remembered that half.
